source: Ken French data library (daily, weekday calendar)

rule.universe: Ken French 12 industries daily value-weighted (weekday calendar)
rule.M0: sector-concentrate-v1 RS12_k2: top-2 equal weight, reset every month
rule.variants: equal-weight reset only when a name changes; buffer keeps held names ranked within top K
rule.harvest: last trading day of December: sell held industries with unrealized KRW loss at close, buy back at next trading day's close (cash 0% for one day)
rule.timing: signal = close before decision day d; trade at close of d; each window is a fresh account

thresholds.subperiods: after-tax CAGR > market in 1967-1986 and 1987-2007 (fresh accounts)

tax_approx: approximation: tax_fx.simulate on industry total-return index levels as prices, 30,000,000 KRW, fixed 1 USD = 1,300 KRW, 22% on realized gains above 2.5M KRW/yr, no loss carry-forward, fee 10bp, no FX cost/dividend tax, liquidation-adjusted at window end

etf.source: yfinance (Close / Adj Close), USDKRW via tax_fx.usdkrw_series
